styling: Existing CSS token system in frontend/src/styles.css and frontend/src/styles/electracom-theme.css
motion: Existing browser behavior only; no motion dependency is installed
audience: Field commissioning engineers reviewing MQTT and UDMI evidence
primary_use: Find registered assets, verify where they published, inspect payload compliance, and manage generated reports

Require engineer permission and explicit confirmation for report deletion
